title: KYC verification
goal: Verify borrower identity (PAN + Aadhaar + liveness) before loan disbursal

steps.name: collect-documents
steps.how: Collect PAN and Aadhaar images via borrower upload link

steps.name: ckyc-lookup
steps.how: Query CKYC registry with PAN; reconcile name and DOB

steps.name: liveness-check
steps.how: Selfie liveness plus face match against Aadhaar photo

title: EMI reconciliation
goal: Match EMI debits in the settlement bank statement against the loan repayment schedule and flag misses

steps.name: pull-statement
steps.how: Pull settlement bank statement rows for the EMI cycle window

steps.name: match-debits
steps.how: Join debits to schedule on loan_id and amount within tolerance
